sentences.en: TEACHER: Before we start, Spiros and Hiroko, thanks for coming in today to talk about your recent study experiences and congratulations to you both in doing so well in your first semester exams!
sentences.zh: TEACHER: 开始之前，斯皮罗斯和广子，感谢你们今天前来分享近期的学习经历，同时也祝贺你们在第一学期考试中取得了优异的成绩！

sentences.en: I'd like to discuss with you the value of the English for Academic Purposes course you did here last year before starting your university course.
sentences.zh: 我想和你们探讨一下，去年在开始大学课程之前，你们在这里修读的学术英语课程的价值。

sentences.en: Spiros, if I could start with you, what parts of the programme have now proved to be particularly valuable to you?
sentences.zh: 斯皮罗斯，如果我可以先从你开始的话，该课程中哪些部分如今被证明对你特别有价值？

sentences.en: SPIROS: I think that having to do a seminar presentation really helped me.
sentences.zh: SPIROS: 我认为必须完成一次研讨会报告这一环节确实对我帮助很大。

sentences.en: For example, a couple of weeks ago in our marketing subject, when it was my turn to give a presentation I felt quite confident.
sentences.zh: 例如，几周前在我们的市场营销课上，轮到我做报告时，我感到相当自信。

sentences.en: Of course, was still nervous but because I had done one before, I knew what to expect.
sentences.zh: 当然，我还是有些紧张，但因为我之前已做过一次，所以我知道会遇到什么情况。

sentences.en: Also, I know I was well-prepared and had practised my timing.
sentences.zh: 此外，我也清楚自己准备得很充分，并且反复练习过时间把控。

sentences.en: In fact, I think that in relation to some of the other people in my group, I did quite a good job because my overall style was quite professional.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我认为相较于小组中的其他同学，我的表现相当不错，因为我的整体风格显得颇为专业。

sentences.en: What about you, Hiroko?
sentences.zh: 那么你呢，广子？

sentences.en: HIROKO: Mmm, that's interesting.
sentences.zh: HIROKO: 嗯，这很有趣。

sentences.en: In my group, I was really surprised by the way the students did their presentations - they just read their notes aloud!
sentences.zh: 在我所在的小组里，我对同学们做报告的方式感到非常惊讶——他们只是照着笔记大声朗读！

sentences.en: Can you believe that?
sentences.zh: 你能相信吗？

sentences.en: They didn't worry about their presentation style or keeping eye contact with their audience - and I remember that these things were really stressed to us in the course here.
sentences.zh: 他们完全不关心自己的报告风格，也不注意与听众保持眼神交流——而这些要点，我们在本校的课程中曾被反复强调。

sentences.en: TEACHER: So, how did you approach you prepepsige.cureko?
sentences.zh: TEACHER: 那么，广子，你是如何准备你的报告的呢？

sentences.en: Tapescripts + Vs
sentences.zh: Tapescripts + Vs

sentences.en: HIROKO: Well, to speak frankly, I read my notes too!
sentences.zh: HIROKO: 哦，坦白说，我当时也照着笔记念了！

sentences.en: At the time. twas a relief to l0- 194 it this way, but actually when I had finished, didn't feel any real sense of
sentences.zh: 当时这样处理让我松了一口气，但其实讲完之后，我并没有产生任何真正的满足感。

sentences.en: SPIROS: satisfaction. didn't feel positive about the experience at all. alonso.2C.com That's a pity.
sentences.zh: SPIROS: 一点也没有，我对这次经历完全没有任何积极感受。alonso.2C.com 真遗憾。

sentences.en: You know, although was pleased with my presentation, Lam not so pleased with my actual performance right now in the tutorials - during the whole semester I've not said anything in our tutorial discussions.
sentences.zh: 你知道，尽管我对自己的报告感到满意，但我对自己目前在辅导课上的实际表现却不太满意——整个学期以来，我在辅导课讨论中一句话都没说过。

sentences.en: Not a word.
sentences.zh: 一个字都没说。

sentences.en: HIROKO: Really, Spiros?
sentences.zh: HIROKO: 真的吗，斯皮罗斯？

sentences.en: Why's that?
sentences.zh: 为什么呢？

sentences.en: Do the other students talk too much?
sentences.zh: 是其他同学说得太多了吗？

sentences.en: SPIROS: It's partly that, but it's mostly because I have had no confidence to speak out.
sentences.zh: SPIROS: 这部分原因确实存在，但最主要的原因是我缺乏开口发言的信心。

sentences.en: Their style of speaking is so different - it's not the style we were used to during the course.
sentences.zh: 他们的说话方式差异太大了——这并非我们在课程中所习惯的那种风格。

sentences.en: They use so many colloquialisms, they're not very polite and sometimes there seems to be no order in their discussion.
sentences.zh: 他们大量使用口语化表达，礼貌程度不高，有时讨论甚至显得毫无条理。

sentences.en: Also, they are very familiar with each other, so because they know each other's habits, they can let each other into the discussion.
sentences.zh: 此外，他们彼此之间非常熟悉，因此了解对方的习惯，便能自然地让对方加入讨论。

sentences.en: HIROKO: You're right, Spiros, I've experienced that too.
sentences.zh: HIROKO: 斯皮罗斯，你说得对，我也经历过这种情况。

sentences.en: HIROKO: For most of this semester, I've said absolutely nothing in tutorials.
sentences.zh: HIROKO: 整个学期的大部分时间里，我在辅导课上完全一言不发。

sentences.en: But recently, I've been trying to speak up more and I just jump in, and I've noticed an interesting thing, I've noticed that if they thought my point was interesting or new, then the next time they actually asked for my opinion, and then it was much easier for me to be part of the discussion.
sentences.zh: 但最近，我开始努力多发言，直接抓住时机插话；我还注意到一件有趣的事：如果他们觉得我的观点有意思或新颖，下一次他们就会主动征求我的意见，这样一来，我就更容易融入讨论了。

sentences.en: SPIROS: That's great, Hiroko!
sentences.zh: SPIROS: 太棒了，广子！

sentences.en: I hope that happens for me next semester - I'll have to work hard to find some interesting points.
sentences.zh: 我希望下学期我也能有这种机会——我得加倍努力，找出一些有意思的观点。

sentences.en: What helped you to find these ideas?
sentences.zh: 是什么帮你找到了这些观点？

sentences.en: HIROKO: I think that one thing that helped me with this was the reading.
sentences.zh: HIROKO: 我觉得，其中一项对我有帮助的是阅读。

sentences.en: I've had to do so much reading this semester just to help me make sense of the lectures.
sentences.zh: 这个学期我不得不进行大量阅读，只为帮助自己理解讲座内容。

sentences.en: At first I couldn't understand what the lecturers were talking about, so I had to turn to the books and journals.
sentences.zh: 起初我根本听不懂讲师在讲什么，因此只能求助于教材和期刊。

sentences.en: Every night read for hours, using the lists of references that were given, and I made pages of notes.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上我都花数小时阅读，依据提供的参考文献清单，并做了厚厚几页笔记。

sentences.en: At breakfast, I read and read my notes again.
sentences.zh: 早餐时，我又一遍遍重读这些笔记。

sentences.en: This habit has helped me to follow the ideas in the lectures, and it's also given me some ideas to use in the tutorials.
sentences.zh: 这种习惯不仅帮助我跟上讲座中的思路，也为我在辅导课讨论中提供了可用的观点。

sentences.en: SPIROS: But did so much reading anyway - don't think there's any time left over for anything extra.
sentences.zh: SPIROS: 可是阅读量已经这么大了——我觉得根本没剩下任何额外时间去做别的事。

sentences.en: My reading speed is still quite slow, though I'm much better at dealing with vocabulary than I used to be.
sentences.zh: 我的阅读速度仍然相当慢，尽管我在处理词汇方面比以前强多了。

sentences.en: TEACHER: What else do you think we could add to the course program to help with this reading problem?
sentences.zh: TEACHER: 为了帮助解决这个阅读问题，您认为我们还可以在课程计划中增加些什么？

sentences.en: SPIROS: There's not really anything because it's my problem. remember we were given long articles to read.
sentences.zh: SPIROS: 其实没什么可加的，因为这是我的个人问题。还记得我们曾被要求阅读长篇文章吗？

sentences.en: We didn't like that but now I realise that reading those long articles was good preparation for the things I need to read now.
sentences.zh: 当时我们并不喜欢那样做，但现在我意识到，阅读那些长篇文章其实为我现在需要阅读的内容做了很好的准备。

sentences.en: Also, in class we regularly had speed-reading tasks to do, and we kept a record of our reading speed, so the teachers were encouraging us to work on that.
sentences.zh: 此外，课堂上我们定期进行速读练习，并记录自己的阅读速度，因此老师一直在鼓励我们在这方面下功夫。

sentences.en: HIROKO: That's true Spiros, but what we read could have been different.
sentences.zh: HIROKO: 的确如此，Spiros，但当时我们所读的内容本可以有所不同。

sentences.en: Sometimes in the English class I felt frustrated when I had to read articles about the environment or health or education, because I wanted to concentrate on my own field, but we didn't read anything about engineering.
sentences.zh: 有时在英语课上，当我不得不阅读有关环境、健康或教育的文章时，我会感到沮丧，因为我本想专注于自己的专业领域，而我们却从未读过任何与工程相关的内容。

sentences.en: So, I think I wasted some time learning vocabulary I didn't need.
sentences.zh: 所以，我觉得自己花了一些时间学习了并不需要的词汇，白白浪费了时间。

sentences.en: TEACHER: But surely the strategies you were taught for dealing with that vocabulary were helpful.
sentences.zh: TEACHER: 但您所学的应对这些词汇的策略，肯定对您有帮助吧？

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com

sentences.en: HIROKO: Yes, but psychologically speaking, L would have felt much better working on reading from my own field.
sentences.zh: HIROKO: 是的，但从心理层面来说，如果我能专注于自己专业领域的阅读材料，我的感受会好得多。

sentences.en: What do you think Spiros?
sentences.zh: Spiros，您怎么看？

sentences.en: SPIROS: I agree; that would have helped my confidence too and would have been more motivated.
sentences.zh: SPIROS: 我同意；这也会增强我的自信心，并让我更有学习动力。

sentences.en: It was good though that we could work on our own topics when we wrote the research assignments.
sentences.zh: 不过，我们在撰写研究作业时能自主选择主题，这一点还是很好的。

sentences.en: TEACHER: Okay, let's move on to writing now
sentences.zh: TEACHER: 好的，下面我们来讨论写作部分。
